name: Abijah
summary: A son of Rehoboam who reigned three years over Judah in Jerusalem. He walked in his father's sins, yet he won a great battle against Jeroboam when Judah relied on the LORD.

key_moments.title: King After Rehoboam
key_moments.description: Abijam began to reign over Judah in Jeroboam's eighteenth year and reigned three years in Jerusalem. He walked in his father's sins, yet for David's sake the LORD gave him a lamp in Jerusalem.

key_moments.title: Speech on Mount Zemaraim
key_moments.description: Abijah stood on Mount Zemaraim and called out to Jeroboam and the army of Israel. He said they had cast out the LORD's priests and had golden calves for gods, but Judah had not forsaken God.

key_moments.title: Victory Over Jeroboam
key_moments.description: Jeroboam set an ambush behind Judah, but the men of Judah cried to the LORD, and God struck Jeroboam's army. Abijah chased him and took cities from him, including Bethel.
